notes:
Lead source: inbound (self-serve signup). CTO: Maya Torres (early-stage scaling).
Key pain: slow internal search + repetitive support tickets — want 70% deflection via chat + fast document retrieval.
Prod targets: 200 concurrent support sessions peak, 200k tokens/day initially, latency target 150-300ms per token on hosted API.
Cost sensitivity: high. Startups budget; prefers predictable per-ticket pricing. Asks: 'Can we start on CC and switch to invoice later if we commit?'
Procurement wants simple flow — startup discount would close quickly. Maya asked for a 60-day free credits extension to finish integration tests and reduce risk before committing a CC.
Technical notes: plan to use embeddings for search (approx 25M tokens/month estim.), reranking experiment later. Want retention controls and audit logs but not ISO-level compliance initially.
Sales snippets: "Candidate for quick conversion if we extend credits + confirm CC vs invoice path."
Objections: billing card limits, need to preserve card for other infra costs, finance would prefer invoice for >$10k/mo.
Decision maker: CTO Maya; influencer: Head of Ops (Liam Chen).
Recommended offer: 90-day trial credits extension (deferred billing) + 10% startup discount code; allow CC on sign-up and add invoice conversion process tied to usage threshold.
Next deliverables: short SOW for POC, one-page billing options doc, confirm trial-credits amount by 2026-03-16.
